model: proper cubic rotations; one fixed root; finite face-distance corona exact cover

method.continuation_solver: exact conflict-backjumping GCTS with fixed outer placements
method.cut: a fixed-placement obstruction clause extracted only after exact continuation exhaustion
method.symmetry_closure: every sound cut closed under the root polycube stabilizer
method.one_step_coverability: optional exact necessary-condition encoding requires every next-ring cell to retain at least one placement compatible with the selected outer patch; conflict-set dominance removes locally redundant candidate placements
method.bounded_copy_semantics: UNSAT with max_placements set exhausts only that copy-count stratum and is never classified as non-tiling

interpretation: The positive control shows that low-copy CEGAR can leave the dense dead-state basin and recover a known extendable stratum. For p9-42947, every one of 279 proposed radius-four patches is exactly obstructed at radius five, including 29 economical patches and eleven 63-copy patches. The one-step coverability filter removes immediate dead targets from its four satisfiable proposals, forcing GCTS to learn deeper resolved-subtree clauses. The radius-four state space remains unexhausted; eight max-62 attempts and one coverability-filtered max-63 attempt timed out. These results prove neither non-tiling nor aperiodicity.
